summary.headline: Sai Silks Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR375 crore (vs INR379 crore) as SSSG fell 7.5–7.8%; FY27 revenue growth guidance of 12–15% retained.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations was INR375 crore against INR379 crore a year earlier, with same-store sales degrowth of up to 7.5% (about 7.5–7.8% per Q&A). Management blamed Adhik Maas (May 17 to June 15), weak discretionary consumer sentiment and a high base (Q1 FY26 SSSG was double digit). EBITDA margin declined about 1% on fixed-cost deleverage, while gross margin held close to 42% (down 10–15 bps). Management retained full-year guidance of 12–15% revenue growth and an EBITDA margin better than FY26, and asked investors to judge the business annually rather than quarterly. Store count reached 83 with about 8,14,000 sq ft; one KLM Fashion Mall store in Telangana is being closed.

segments.name: Kalamandir (format)
segments.commentary: Majority of FY27 expansion; two new large Kalamandir stores (about 14,000 and 15,000 sq ft) opened in Karnataka in Q1, with brand strength cited as higher in Karnataka than Telangana.

segments.name: Varamahalakshmi (format)
segments.commentary: Co-lead format for FY27 expansion, with a pause in new Valli Silks stores of about 1–3 quarters due to higher rent-to-revenue (Valli stores 3,000–4,000 sq ft); next wave planned from Q4 FY27 or FY28.

segments.name: KLM Fashion Mall (Telangana)
segments.commentary: Sustained degrowth; one store being closed (store count 19 to 18), with inventory and staff to be moved to other KLM and upcoming stores. Innerwear reportedly growing and fashion jewellery only just being added; innerwear growth expected about 20% YoY.

segments.name: Telangana cluster
segments.commentary: Sharp decline of about 15% cited by analyst, linked to KLM; Dasara shift from Q2 to Q3 affects Telangana, a significant revenue contributor.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 12–15% retained; management said it aims for around 15%, implying roughly 2–3% SSSG plus new-store revenue.
FY27 EBITDA margin expected to be better than FY26 closing; gross margin targeted to be maintained through the year despite cost pressures.

Net retail space addition target of about 1,00,000 sq ft for FY27; visibility of 26,000–30,000 sq ft in Q2 (total 58,000–60,000 sq ft after Q1 addition), 40,000 sq ft targeted for Q3–Q4, with possible extra 10,000–15,000 sq ft in Q4.
Entry into Pune (Maharashtra) and exploration of Kerala expected in Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28.
Management indicated SSSG improvement of about 3–4% in the coming year as guidance basis, plus productivity from maturing and new stores.
Warehouse capex: deal for one location targeted by end-September 2026; full IPO fund utilisation targeted by September quarter 2026.
Wedding dates in Q2–Q4 expected to be 5–10% higher YoY; Sravana Masam from mid-August expected to lift demand.
capex_capacity: Added about 30,000 sq ft in Q1 FY27, taking store count to 83 and footprint to about 8,14,000 sq ft.

FY27 target of about 1,00,000 sq ft net addition, with management hinting at slightly more before year-end; total store-area addition in IPO plan was 1,42,500 sq ft, and about 90,000–1,00,000 sq ft extra was added within the same funds (about 80,000–90,000 sq ft per CFO).
Store split: Karnataka 14, Tamil Nadu 14, Telangana 28–29, Andhra Pradesh 28 (approximate, per CEO); Karnataka the lead growth market.
Warehouse: one of 1–2 identified locations under due diligence; deal targeted by end-September 2026.
Inventory per sq ft declining as cluster density improves; all stores company-owned, company-operated.
demand_pricing: Demand weak: value-conscious and discretionary purchasing; management attributes the Q1 weakness mainly to Adhik Maas, and also cites geopolitical factors, fuel and dyeing cost increases, and El Nino/poor rainfall in agrarian markets (AP, Telangana, Karnataka account for about 75% of revenue per analyst).
Post Adhik Maas (about 15–20 days after), demand slowly rising but below normal levels, per CEO.
Average ticket size about INR4,000–5,000; 95–96% of products sold at full price.
Management says it is the only listed ethnic wear player, so no direct peer comparison; jewellery growth of 35–40% cited by an analyst as a contrast.
Marketplaces (Amazon, Myntra) ruled out due to 20–45% commissions and high returns; e-commerce is a small channel.

qa_highlights.question: State-wise and format-wise split of the 1 lakh sq ft FY27 target, and any entry outside South India?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly existing territories, led by Karnataka; Kalamandir leads, with Varamahalakshmi also in play. New-state entry (Pune, Maharashtra; Kerala explored) expected in Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 guidance unchanged?
qa_highlights.answer: Broadly unchanged; revenue growth guidance of 12–15% for the full year, with potential upside if stores open late Q3 or early Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company guide revenue growth and is rainfall a risk to demand?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated 12–15% guidance and said agri-dependent cities (Rajahmundry, Vijayawada) are exposed; rainfall impact is expected to show in Q2–Q3 and is hard to quantify.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin outlook given supply chain cost pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin lost about 10–15 bps; the company aims to hold gross margin through year-end, with EBITDA margin better than FY26.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the Telangana decline is from KLM, and what is the SSSG? Will KLM drag results?
qa_highlights.answer: SSSG about 7.5–7.8%, driven largely by KLM (mostly Telangana) plus the high base; one KLM store is being closed, with inventory and staff transferred.

qa_highlights.question: Wedding dates and Valli format performance?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2–Q4 has about 5–10% more wedding dates YoY, distributed evenly; Dasara shifts from Q2 to Q3. Valli operates at or slightly above Kalamandir productivity, but expansion is paused for 1–3 quarters due to high rent.

qa_highlights.question: Does the guidance imply flat or negative SSSG for the rest of FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said the 7% degrowth is a catch-up issue; the full year should balance, with about 15% growth implying around 2–3% positive SSSG.

qa_highlights.question: Why was revenue flat despite 14 new stores, and what is the demand trend in July?
qa_highlights.answer: Higher base and SSSG degrowth from Adhik Maas and lower consumption; demand improving post-Adhik Maas, with Sravana Masam from mid-August expected to help.

qa_highlights.question: Employee cost drop from Q4 to Q1, and how is SSSG maturity measured?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 had bonuses and seasonal temporary staff; Q1 lower. SSSG maturity measured as the year of opening plus one year; FY27 guidance assumes 3–4% SSSG improvement plus maturing and new-store productivity.

qa_highlights.question: Warehouse funds unutilised since IPO?
qa_highlights.answer: One of 1–2 locations under due diligence; deal targeted by end-September 2026, with full fund utilisation expected in the September quarter 2026.

risks_watch: Sustained SSSG degrowth (-7.5% to -7.8% in Q1) with guidance relying on a recovery to about +2–3% SSSG in H2.
Rainfall, El Nino and agri-income exposure in AP, Telangana and Karnataka (about 75% of revenue per analyst), with impact expected in Q2–Q3.
Cost pressure from fuel, dyeing and supply chain, which could erode gross margin beyond the 10–15 bps already lost.
KLM Fashion Mall Telangana degrowth, with a second store under review.
Store addition pace: Q2 visibility of 26,000–30,000 sq ft; Q3–Q4 target of 40,000 sq ft, dependent on timing.
Valli Silks expansion paused 1–3 quarters due to high rent-to-revenue; warehouse capex still unallocated.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term growth and full-year guidance, but defensive and cautious on Q1, repeatedly asking investors to judge the business annually. Management was less precise on quarterly drivers and on Q2–Q3 rainfall and demand impacts, and it deflected a question on the non-attendance of a senior executive.

But broadly, Y-o-Y basis, it's still fine.
Sir, the reason why I've mentioned that number is because we have a lot of catching up to do, this minus 7%. But broadly, we feel for the full year, it is going to balance out.

So we don't have margins like that to operate in channels like that, and we continue to keep our stores in offline mode and stand-alone as well.

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 12-15% (midpoint 13.5%) was held, backed by a ~1,00,000 sq ft net retail addition (about 30,000 sq ft done in Q1, 26,000-30,000 sq ft visible in Q2), but Q1 revenue was flat YoY (INR375 crore vs INR379 crore) with SSSG down 7.5-7.8%, so the guidance relies on a 2-3% SSSG recovery that is not yet visible.
